name: rst-benchmark
description: Cross-library performance benchmark: this fork vs react-sortable-tree vs @minoru/react-dnd-treeview

scripts.setup: cd .. && npm run build && npm pack --pack-destination benchmark/vendor
scripts.bench: node build.mjs && node run.mjs && node report.mjs

//dnd: Two drag-and-drop stacks on purpose: the fork uses @nosferatu500/react-dnd 19, @minoru/react-dnd-treeview needs upstream react-dnd 16. Installing only one would make a harness unbuildable.
